senses.gloss:
Kauthuma
Q. in Prameyaratnāvalī of Baladeva Vidyābhūṣaṇa (Saṁs. Sāh. Pariṣat Series 18. p. 103). This is Chāndogya Up.

Kauthumagṛhyasūtra
Mysore I. p. 68 (21 khaṇḍas). PUL. II. App. p. 30.
Ed.. Suryakanta, Bib. Ind. Calcutta, 1956.

Kauthumapariśiṣṭa
Sv. PUL. I. p. 131.
This comprises: Viśeṣasūtra, Ṛksaṁkhyā, Sandhyāsūtra, Chalaprakriyā, Uttarahitavākya, Praṇatapariśiṣṭa, Kuśaṇḍi, Vināyakaśānti an. Avagrahapariśiṣṭa.

Kauthumi
dh. Q. by Hemādri in Pariśeṣakhaṇḍa II, 42. 50; by Raghunandana in Tithitattva; in Kālamādhava (See Kane, HDS. I. p. 689b); in Hārīta Veṅkaṭācārya's Sudhīvilocana, C. on his own Pitṛmedhasāra (p. 182. Telugu script edn. Mysore, 1896).

Kauthumisāmagānāṃ_Saṃskāraprayoga
part of Śivārkodaya by Gāgā Bhaṭṭa, metrical C. on Kumārila's Vārttika. (L. 2047). RASB. II. 1371. [Page107-b]

Kauthumīyamāsaśrāddhaikoddiṣṭaprayoga
Sv. gṛh. p.. by Subrahmaṇya. Trav. Uni. 9964 A. B.

Kauthumīyāparasūtrabhāṣya
Sv. by Makhasvāmin. Sri. Dev. 329.
